display.name: 网关画像存储健康
display.description: 统一核心图表；来源特有指标列于专属诊断。单位见标题，统计差异见图表提示。

display.name: 画像队列（事件）
display.description:
指标含义
等待画像后台写入的事件队列长度。一个请求可产生多个事件，因此不能把事件数当作请求数。持续增长提示画像写入跟不上事件产生速度。

A3 主机网关。按采集环境归属；图例区分本环境的后端或阶段。

display.name: 画像写入错误速率（事件/秒）
display.description:
指标含义
最近 1 分钟画像写入错误计数的平均增长速率。统计对象是画像记录的写入错误，不是下游推理失败或 HTTP 错误。

A3 主机网关。按采集环境归属；图例区分本环境的后端或阶段。

spec.query: (rate(aigate_profile_write_errors_total{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) and (resets(aigate_profile_write_errors_total{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) == 0) and (count_over_time(aigate_profile_write_errors_total{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) >= 12)) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job=~"aigate"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job=~"aigate"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="a3-vllm",job=~"aigate"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) ((changes(aigate_profile_counter_start_time_seconds{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) == 0) and (count_over_time(aigate_profile_counter_start_time_seconds{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) >= 12) and (time() - aigate_profile_counter_start_time_seconds{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"} >= 60) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm"}[1m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm"}[1m]) >= 12))

display.name: 画像事件丢弃速率（事件/秒）
display.description:
指标含义
最近 1 分钟画像丢弃事件计数的平均增长速率。队列满或事件超过记录大小限制等情况可导致丢弃；它说明画像证据不完整，不等于业务请求被丢弃。

A3 主机网关。按采集环境归属；图例区分本环境的后端或阶段。

spec.query: (rate(aigate_profile_dropped_events_total{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) and (resets(aigate_profile_dropped_events_total{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) == 0) and (count_over_time(aigate_profile_dropped_events_total{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) >= 12)) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job=~"aigate"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job=~"aigate"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="a3-vllm",job=~"aigate"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) ((changes(aigate_profile_counter_start_time_seconds{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) == 0) and (count_over_time(aigate_profile_counter_start_time_seconds{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"}[1m]) >= 12) and (time() - aigate_profile_counter_start_time_seconds{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm",request_scope="all"} >= 60) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm"}[1m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="aigate",environment="a3-vllm"}[1m]) >= 12))

display.name: 画像存储量（MiB）
display.description:
指标含义
当前画像记录占用的存储字节数除以 2^20。表示画像文件空间，不是模型权重、KV Cache 或进程内存大小。

A3 主机网关。按采集环境归属；图例区分本环境的后端或阶段。
